title: Good app but
body:
Would be great if on iOS it would synch better with other common apps like my fitness pal, at least the database my fitness pal has which is incredibly extensive. 
Additionally the band disconnects too often and you have to reconnect it frequently.
Moreover, why is there ice dancing as a workout option but no skateboarding? Who is using this app that required ice dancing 😂

Overall a really good way to track exercise in a non-obsessive manner.
